title: Read-only fetch into quarantine
goal: A page or repository is fetched read-only and marked untrusted
acceptance: Shallow clone or page fetch into a per-job directory, discarded afterwards
Content is tainted; no project code runs
A planted instruction in the fetched content does not change the plan (test)
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A change of gate class, data leaving the base, or a material effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-14 from the owner jobs case study, before design. Not a measurement.
